summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K on 26 June 2026 to disclose a routine PDMR share transaction. On 24 June 2026, Chief People Places Officer Sharon Doherty acquired 45,708 ordinary shares at 39.38 pence per share upon exercise of an option under the Lloyds Banking Group Sharesave Scheme 2017. The transaction occurred outside a trading venue. This is an ordinary insider equity award exercise with no special-situation implications such as a takeover, activist campaign, or capital return. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes to analyze. The filing merely satisfies SEC reporting obligations for foreign private issuers.
